name: Kamijou Nagi
source:
Boasting a perfect grade point average, outstanding athletic performance, and calm demeanor, Nagi is the perfect example of the model student. She is respected by her instructors and worshiped by her peers, with a bright and promising future that’s all but ensured to happen: and Nagi knows it.

[from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20070210175338/www.elizar.com/?p=30]Nargrakhan's review[/url]]
